thread:
Noah: Quick heads-up SecureEdge is asking for a joint Marketplace listing (AWS/GCP) + partner webinar. Main integration points: SAML SSO (SP metadata), SCIM provisioning (they use externalId for users/groups), and BYOK via KMIP or PKCS#11 on-prem HSM. Can we assign owners and propose a short timeline? @Priya @Zara

Priya: I can own SSO + SCIM. Need their SP metadata XML, SCIM base URL, and whether they support incremental sync vs full sync. Also confirm their group format (externalId vs id).

Zara: I'll take KMS/HSM. Quick clarifying question: demo can use cloud-wrapped keys, but for enterprise they want BYOK via KMIP. We should confirm supported key wrap algos (RSA-OAEP-256, AES-KW). Also ask if they expose KMIP gateway on a public IP or require VPC peering.

Noah: Partner indicated demo uses cloud wrapped keys, enterprises will use KMIP gateways. They listed Thales + VaultHSM as supported HSMs. Proposed milestone: security review by 2024-05-02, POC by 2024-05-16, dry-run May 24, partner demo May 28. Sound reasonable?

Priya: Sounds fine. Small SCIM detail: they put group membership under `groups.externalId`. We'll map that to our internal id. Example they sent:

```json
{"userName":"joe@secedge.com","externalId":"u-501","displayName":"Joe","groups":[{"externalId":"g-12"}],"active":true}
```

Zara: For BYOK IAM on GCP demo: grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to the demo SA; for import flows add `cloudkms.importCryptoKeyVersion`. I'll add templates. For PKCS#11 we need connector certs and network rules.

Priya: I'll spin up a SCIM test tenant and post creds in the private partner doc. ETA Wed EOD.

InfraBot: FYI: open infra ticket for KMIP egress (port 5696) and indicate if VPC peering is requested. Provide partner CIDRs.

Noah: I'll open the infra ticket and loop in eng-infra. Also ping marketing for the marketplace tile assets (logo SVG, 2-line blurb, 1-pager).

Zara: We should avoid storing plaintext key material. For BYOK we'll store only wrapped key blobs and reference metadata (key id, vendor). For demo we can persist wrapped blob with retention policy 30 days. Add compliance check.

Priya: Testing plan: SCIM provision/unprovision, SAML login smoke, key wrap/unwrap roundtrip. I'll add CI smoke tests.

Noah: Legal: will require co-marketing boilerplate and data-flow attestation. I'll ping legal.

deploy-bot: Label applied: partnership/secureedge, marketplace, security-review

Priya: Action items: collect SP metadata + SCIM creds, create mapping layer for externalId; ETA Wed.

Zara: Action items: draft KMS IAM templates + KMIP config; ETA Thu.

Noah: Action items: infra ticket, webinar scheduling, collect marketing assets. Next sync Friday 9am PT. Drop blockers in the partner doc before then.
